description: The mail accounts and the passwords of Sync443, and nothing else. An account of the extension is a local account (incoming server of type "none", user name = mailboxId, host name "sync443.invalid") whose server carries the preferences sync443.owner (the extension's id) and sync443.mailbox (the mailboxId); every operation but the creation in ensureAccount refuses an account without these marks, and always refuses the "Local Folders" account. Its identities send through a marked "neutral" outgoing server (sync443.invalid, TLS, no credentials) that cannot send. Passwords live in Thunderbird's login manager, realm "Sync443", under an origin written exactly https://host[:port]. Accepted from the background page only. This schema checks the argument types; the implementation checks them again with every value constraint, so that every refusal of a well-typed call is an ExtensionError whose message starts with a code: CONFIG, PERMISSION, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, LOCKED, UNSUPPORTED or INTERNAL.

functions.name: ensureAccount
functions.description: ensureAccount({mailboxId, email, name, fullName}) resolves to {accountKey, identityId, created}. If an account of the extension is marked for mailboxId, it is updated: name (shown name of the account), address, full name only if the identity has none, and every identity of the account sent back to the neutral outgoing server; created is false. Otherwise a local account is created with its default folders (Inbox, Drafts, Templates, Sent, Archives, Trash, each with its special flag), an identity and, if needed, the neutral outgoing server; created is true. An existing server of the same name without the extension's marks is never adopted (CONFLICT). mailboxId: 12 lower-case hexadecimal digits; email: an address of at most 254 characters; name, fullName: 1-256 printable characters.

functions.name: listAccounts
functions.description: listAccounts() resolves to [{accountKey, mailboxId}], the accounts marked for this extension only.

functions.name: accountOfIdentity
functions.description: accountOfIdentity(identityId) resolves to {accountKey, mailboxId} if the identity belongs to an account of the extension, null otherwise (unknown identity, or the identity of another account). identityId: "id" followed by digits.

functions.name: removeAccount
functions.description: removeAccount(accountKey) removes an account of the extension and its files, then the neutral outgoing server once no identity uses it, and resolves to true; to false if no account has this key. Any other account is refused (PERMISSION), "Local Folders" always. accountKey: "account" followed by digits.

functions.name: setSpecialUse
functions.description: setSpecialUse(accountKey, folderPath, use) gives a folder of an account of the extension this special use and no other; no other folder of the account keeps it, and for drafts, sent, templates and archives the identities of the account use this folder. folderPath: absolute path in the account ("/Inbox/Sub"), resolved one folder name at a time, case included; a missing folder is NOT_FOUND. use: inbox, drafts, trash, sent, junk, archives, templates or outbox.

functions.name: getPassword
functions.description: getPassword(origin, username) resolves to the password saved for this origin and user name in the realm "Sync443", or to null. origin: exactly "https://host" or "https://host:port" (lower-case name, canonical IPv4 or bracketed IPv6 address, no port 443); username: 1-256 characters, no control character.

functions.name: setPassword
functions.description: setPassword(origin, username, password) saves the password, replacing the one already saved for this origin and user name in the realm "Sync443". password: 1-1024 characters, no NUL.

functions.name: removePassword
functions.description: removePassword(origin, username) removes the password saved for this origin and user name in the realm "Sync443"; nothing saved: nothing to do. Any failure of the login manager is reported, never ignored.
